description: This file implements NTLM authentication protocols used in libcurl, including generating and decoding NTLM messages (Type 1, Type 2, and Type 3), handling NTLM flags, and managing NTLM-specific data structures.

methods.name: CURLcode ntlm_decode_type2_target(struct Curl_easy * data,const struct bufref * type2ref,struct ntlmdata * ntlm)
methods.description: Decodes the target info from an NTLM type-2 message, extracting and duplicating the target info buffer if present.

methods.name: bool Curl_auth_is_ntlm_supported(void)
methods.description: Returns TRUE indicating NTLM support is available in libcurl.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_decode_ntlm_type2_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const struct bufref * type2ref,struct ntlmdata * ntlm)
methods.description: Decodes an NTLM type-2 message, validating its structure, extracting flags, nonce, and target info.

methods.name: void unicodecpy(unsigned char * dest,const char * src,size_t length)
methods.description: Copies a string into a buffer as UTF-16LE (Unicode) encoding, inserting zero bytes between characters.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_ntlm_type1_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * userp,const char * passwdp,const char * service,const char * hostname,struct ntlmdata * ntlm,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Creates an NTLM type-1 message with default flags and empty domain/workstation fields.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_ntlm_type3_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * userp,const char * passwdp,struct ntlmdata * ntlm,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Generates an NTLM type-3 message, including user, domain, host information, and responses based on NTLM version and flags.

methods.name: void Curl_auth_cleanup_ntlm(struct ntlmdata * ntlm)
methods.description: Frees allocated target info buffer and resets NTLM data structure fields.

methods.name: void ntlm_print_hex(FILE * handle,const char * buf,size_t len)
